definitions.explanation: showing courage and determination in taking action

examples.japanese: {果敢|かかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。

notes:
{果敢|かかん} describes bold, decisive action, especially in challenging situations.

WORD TYPE:
- Na-adjective
- Adverbial form: {果敢|かかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (very common)

WRITING:
- {果|か} (fruit, result, decisive)
- {敢|かん} (daring, brave)

USAGE:
- Always positive connotation
- Implies action despite risks or obstacles
- Often used in sports, business, and military contexts
- Suggests admirable courage
- Sports commentary (aggressive play)
- Business (bold strategies)
- News (courageous actions)
- Military/historical accounts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {果敢|かかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}する→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧ (boldly challenge)
- {果敢|かかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{向|む}かう→立ち向かう：06981_tachimukau⟧ (resolutely face)
- {果敢|かかん}な⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧ (bold attack)
- {果敢|かかん}な⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧ (bold decision)
- {果敢|かかん}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ (resolute attitude)
- {果敢|かかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{攻|せ}める→攻める：02123_semeru⟧ (attack boldly)

- ⟦{勇敢|ゆうかん}→勇敢：07637_yuukan⟧ (brave, courageous)
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧ (positive, proactive)
- {果敢|かかん}: Action-focused, decisive execution
